exposure: severity of dengue infection (dengue fever, DHF, DSS)
stage of disease at diagnosis (first trimester, second trimester, 26-36+6 weeks)
cohort: The study included 62 pregnant women diagnosed with dengue infection who were admitted to Safdarjung Hospital, New Delhi, India, between July and December 2015.
finding: Maternal near miss and mortality were significantly more common among pregnant women with Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) or Dengue Shock Syndrome (DSS) compared to those with dengue fever.
gest_age: first trimester, second trimester, 26-36+6 weeks, 37 weeks (at diagnosis/delivery)
